messages:
emma (eng-oncall): paging: we're seeing a spike of 503s for paging endpoints in eu-west-1 since the canary at 18:03 UTC. errors look like "invalid page token" from the SDKs. anyone on call?

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0453 - paging errors after SDK 1.2.0 rollout. Severity: P2.

oliver (support): hitting this from a handful of customers — they reported failed pagination in feeds and order lists. examples attached in support ticket #8341.

raj (eng-runtime): looking at canary logs now. initial correlation: SDK 1.2.0 changed header encoding for X-Redwood-Page which the runtime used as an opaque marker. downstream services treat it as binary token. looks aligned with report.

zoe (eng-platform): which deployment rolled the client? deploy-bot, can you confirm rollout window for SDK 1.2.0 and if feature flag was flipped?

deploy-bot: SDK release 1.2.0 published 18:01 UTC. Canary cohort: 5% traffic in eu-west-1 started 18:03 UTC. Feature flag "sdk-1-2-compat-mode" default OFF.

emma: ok action plan — 1) open-page kill-switch (edge flag) to stop reading X-Redwood-Page header in runtime, 2) pause canary, 3) notify customers with mitigation. who can flip the kill-switch?

raj: i can flip it on runtime side. doing it now.

raj: flipped "ignore-x-redwood-page" = true at 18:09 UTC across eu-west-1 edge nodes. rolling restart not required.

oliver: immediate support note: customers should see their pagination requests fall back to server-side cursor until we restore compatibility. informing affected customers now.

marta (product): need to confirm customer impact: SLOs affected? how many customers? estimated 12 orgs based on support flags. severity P2 still ok?

emma: SLOs: increased latencies for paged endpoints for some users, ~1.8% error rate for paginated calls in the region. count ~12 orgs, highest-impact ones are two mid-market customers using server-side cursors. keep P2 for now.

incident-bot: Incident updated: mitigation applied - edge kill-switch engaged by raj at 18:09 UTC.

zoe: pausing canary in pkg-registry now. deploy-bot, stop traffic rollout for 1.2.0.

deploy-bot: Canary paused at 18:11 UTC. No further cohorts will receive 1.2.0.

raj: quick note — the runtime code path expected the page token header to be base64 urlsafe; 1.2.0 switched to standard base64 in header encoding which produces +/ characters and our header parser rejects them. patch idea: runtime should accept both encodings (tolerant decode) and SDK should be fixed to use urlsafe.

emma: good. short-term: keep kill-switch. medium-term: update runtime to accept both encodings, validate. long-term: add integration test and contract for header format.

oliver: customer comms draft: "We're aware of pagination errors affecting a subset of customers after our SDK 1.2.0 rollout. We've engaged a mitigation and paused the rollout. You may experience temporary failures when requesting paginated resources; we recommend retrying. We're working on a compatibility fix and will provide timeline." want to send at 18:20 UTC.

marta: send it. add support ticket links and status page update. also mark "workaround: pin to SDK 1.1.x" for customers who can patch quickly.

raj: creating a fast fix branch now: runtime: accept_base64_variants. patch will be small — try/except on header decode then fallback to urlsafe decode. i'll open PR and request a hotfix canary to 1% after internal test.

emma: on-call handoff: i'll stay on until 19:00 UTC or until rollback confirmed. who's owning the postmortem?

zoe: platform will own postmortem and release gating updates. tag me and eng-oncall in the doc.

incident-bot: New postmortem doc created: /incidents/2026-0453-paging-sdk-compat.md (private).

raj: code PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/4521 - tests added, local sims pass. requesting expedited review from zoe.

zoe: reviewing now. once approved, can we do a targeted hotfix canary to 1% for eu-west-1 only? need to ensure no regressions on other header formats.

raj: yes. will coordinate with deploy-bot for a 1% hotfix canary and will monitor for 10 minutes.

deploy-bot: Hotfix canary (runtime@accept-base64-variants) scheduled for eu-west-1 at 18:34 UTC to 1% traffic.

emma: support, please send update to affected customers: mitigation engaged + hotfix canary planned. include expected time windows.

oliver: sending updates now. template updated with canary link and support ticket IDs.

marta: product note — also need to suspend automated billing for any failing flows that could double-charge, double-check with finance if any retries triggered extra invoices.

emma: good catch. tagging finance in the postmortem doc.

incident-bot: Hotfix canary started at 18:34 UTC. Monitoring channels open.

raj: hotfix looks clean so far. no 503s observed in the 1% cohort after decoding fallback. logs show both decoding paths exercised.

oliver: support seeing fewer new tickets. customers on the canary cohort reported success in manual tests.

zoe: approved. ramp to 10% then 50% if green.

deploy-bot: scaling hotfix to 10% at 18:46 UTC.

emma: i'm going to put a status update on the public status page at 18:50 UTC: "Mitigation applied, hotfix rolling — expect recovery over next 30-60 minutes."

marta: also prepare a post-incident customer FAQ: cause, mitigation, timeline, workaround (pin to 1.1.x), ETA for SDK patch (1.2.1) and runtime patch.

raj: after 20 minutes at 10% and 50% ramps, no regressions. ready to roll to 100% for eu-west-1 at 19:10 UTC.

deploy-bot: Hotfix rolled to 100% in eu-west-1 at 19:11 UTC. Canary paused.

incident-bot: Incident resolved (mitigated) at 19:12 UTC. Root cause analysis pending.

emma: summary: cause = SDK 1.2.0 header encoding change incompatible with runtime parser. mitigation = edge kill-switch + runtime tolerant decode hotfix + paused SDK rollout. next steps: 1) release SDK 1.2.1 with urlsafe encoding corrected, 2) publish runtime PR and stable release, 3) postmortem doc, 4) add integration test and contract, 5) follow-ups for billing check. owners: raj (hotfix/runtime), zoe (postmortem), marta (customer comms).

oliver: closing loop with customers. will confirm resolved in tickets and mark RCA subscription.

marta: thanks team. adding timeline and owners to postmortem.

emma: on-call handoff note: i will write an after-action summary and hand to next oncall (sam) at 19:00 UTC, but i'm staying until final green at 19:15.

raj: PRs to follow: runtime#4521 (hotfix), sdk#331 (1.2.1 patch), postmortem link. will link once merged.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0453 status: mitigated.

emma: thanks everyone — nice quick coordination. follow-up items in the postmortem.
